Hi Sara —

Really excited to run this with you. Quick ask: can we shift the demo by 48–72 hours? I flagged Ben to coordinate the ingest slots and Aditya to approve a small extra run (should be covered under the trial). If you can share the cleaned sample CSV and a link to any example prompt templates (or a short doc), that will speed the dry run.

Cheers,
